content: Our paper on edge-guided semi-supervised 6D pose estimation has been accepted by Expert Systems With Applications!
Our robotic grasping work "Occlusion-aware 6D Pose Estimation..." has been accepted by ICRA 2025! See you in Atlanta.
Dr. Yang Jing got 1 Principal Investigator (PI) project granted from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC), focusing on spatial-spectral fusion for hyperspectral images.
Two papers on nonconvex tensor representation and deep unfolding tensor representation networks have been accepted by IEEE J-STARS and Remote Sensing respectively!
Our paper "Robotic Grasp Detection Using Structure Prior Attention..." has been accepted by IEEE TSMC-S!
Our research on clustering guided rule interpolation for ANFIS construction has been accepted by FUZZ-IEEE 2024!
Dr. Yang Jing stands as a key participant in a newly funded NSFC project focusing on robotic grasping optimization mechanisms under dynamic illumination.
Dr. Yang Jing successfully obtained a research grant from the Basic Research Program of Shanxi Province as Principal Investigator.
Our paper on hierarchical spatio-spectral fusion via sparse representation has been accepted by Knowledge-Based Systems!
Our paper "Constructing ANFIS with Sparse Data through Group-Based Rule Interpolation..." has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Fuzzy Systems!
Our collaborative work on ANFIS construction has been published in IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics!
